content.value_statement: Landing pages often fail because value, proof, and action are unclear. This skill gives structured design rules for stronger heroes, CTAs, visuals, forms, and mobile layouts.
actual_capabilities: Defines above-the-fold elements for landing pages, including headline, subheadline, hero image, CTA, and proof.
Provides headline formulas and examples for outcome-focused marketing copy.
Gives CTA text, button design, and placement guidance for conversion-focused pages.
Recommends landing page section order from hero through final CTA.
Includes mobile optimization, form design, page speed, and OG image guidance.
Shows optional belt CLI examples for AI image generation and research prompts.
limitations: It provides guidance, not validated conversion results for a specific audience.
External research and image generation examples require the belt CLI and remote services.
It does not replace accessibility, legal, privacy, or brand review.
It does not include implementation code for a complete landing page.

use_cases.title: Launch a Startup Page
use_cases.description: Create a clear first version of a landing page with a strong hero, focused CTA, and trust signals.

use_cases.title: Improve a SaaS Product Page
use_cases.description: Review headline clarity, proof placement, feature order, pricing flow, and final CTA alignment.

use_cases.title: Guide Visual Direction
use_cases.description: Generate outcome-focused image prompts for hero sections, product context, and social sharing assets.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Hero Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a landing page first screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the landing-page-design skill to review this hero section: [paste headline, subheadline, CTA, proof, and image idea]. Identify the top five changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Landing Page Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured page planning for a new offer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the landing-page-design skill to create a landing page section outline for [product], aimed at [audience], with the primary action [CTA].

prompt_templates.title: Improve Conversion Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Rewrite page copy around value and action.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the landing-page-design skill to rewrite my headline, subheadline, CTA, and proof statement for clarity and conversion. Here is the current copy: [paste copy].

prompt_templates.title: Audit Full Landing Page Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across layout, proof, forms, mobile, and speed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the landing-page-design skill to audit this landing page plan for conversion risks, missing proof, weak CTAs, mobile issues, and visual direction: [paste plan].

output_examples.input: A founder asks for a landing page structure for a new analytics product.
output_examples.output: A recommended section order with a clear hero promise, primary CTA, proof bar, problem section, three feature blocks, pricing, FAQ, and final CTA.

output_examples.input: A product marketer shares weak CTA and headline copy.
output_examples.output: Several rewritten headline options, stronger CTA labels, and notes explaining which changes make the offer clearer.

output_examples.input: A designer needs a hero image direction for a SaaS page.
output_examples.output: Outcome-focused visual concepts that show customer success, product context, and social sharing assets without relying on generic stock imagery.

best_practices: Lead with the customer outcome before explaining features or process.
Use one primary CTA and repeat it after major decision points.
Pair every major claim with proof, such as logos, numbers, testimonials, or case study results.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague headlines such as welcome messages or broad growth claims.
Do not make the hero image a hard-to-read dashboard screenshot without context.
Do not ask for unnecessary form fields before the visitor understands the value.

faq.question: Does this skill build the landing page for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides design, copy, layout, and visual direction guidance that you can apply in your own tools.

faq.question: Can I use it for SaaS landing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance directly covers SaaS heroes, CTAs, proof, pricing, forms, and conversion-focused section order.

faq.question: Does it require the belt CLI?
faq.answer: Only the optional image generation and research examples require belt. The design guidance can be used without external tools.

faq.question: Will it guarantee a higher conversion rate?
faq.answer: No. It applies common conversion principles, but results depend on audience, offer, traffic source, and testing.

faq.question: Can it help with mobile landing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes mobile rules for CTA placement, tap targets, font size, responsive images, and layout simplicity.

faq.question: Is it suitable for non-technical teams?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is written as practical design and marketing rules, not engineering instructions.
